name: hcapp_addEditEvent
description: Creates or updates an HC.Event record. If @eventId exists, performs an update; if not, inserts a new event. The deletion path (@deleted=1) is completely stubbed out — the entire delete block is commented out. After the write, delegates to hcapp_syncUserData to return refreshed data. Returns no direct confirmation rowset — all results come from the sync call.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID for auth lookup.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token.

parameters.name: narrowEventsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed through to hcapp_syncUserData. Required — no default.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update. If null or null-UUID, triggers insert mode. Null-UUID (00000000...) is normalised to NULL internally.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Required for insert mode. Null-UUID normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: startDatetime
parameters.description: Required for insert mode. Sentinel: values <= 1/1/1901 are normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: endDatetime
parameters.description: Sentinel: values <= 1/1/1901 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: isCountedRun
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (don't update).

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: usersCanEditRunAttendence
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 = set to NULL. Maps to Event.CanEditRunAttendence.

parameters.name: ThemeRunType

parameters.name: eventName

parameters.name: eventDescription
parameters.description: Sentinel: DATALENGTH < 2 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears the field. Unicode paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) stripped.

parameters.description: Sentinel: DATALENGTH < 2 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears.

parameters.description: Sentinel: DATALENGTH < 2 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears. Also accidentally used for Event.Hares in the INSERT (bug — INSERT uses @locationOneLineDesc instead of @hares for the Hares column).

parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. When 1, the delete path is hit but is completely stubbed — no DELETE or soft-delete actually executes.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter

parameters.name: hares
parameters.description: Comma-separated string of hasher IDs for hares. Sentinel: DATALENGTH < 4 normalised to NULL. '<remove>' clears. Unicode paragraph separators stripped. NOTE: The INSERT path has a bug — it inserts @locationOneLineDesc into the Hares column instead of @hares.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Event — when @eventId is null or not found
EXEC HC5.hcapp_syncUserData — returns multiple result sets (see syncUserData contract)

codeSmells.issue: INSERT bug: @locationOneLineDesc used instead of @hares for Event.Hares column
codeSmells.detail: In the INSERT branch (lines 421-428), the Hares column is populated with 'case when @locationOneLineDesc = '<remove>' then null else @locationOneLineDesc end' instead of @hares. The actual @hares value is ignored on insert.

codeSmells.issue: Deletion path is completely stubbed out
codeSmells.detail: When @deleted=1, the entire deletion block is commented out. The SP falls through to nonApi_updateRunNumbers and syncUserData without making any change. Callers that set @deleted=1 silently get no effect.
@eventPriceForMembers, @eventPriceForNonMembers, and @eventPriceForExtras are all FLOAT. Should be DECIMAL(10,4).
The nonApi call runs after the UPDATE/INSERT, with no wrapping transaction. If it fails, the event write has already committed.

codeSmells.issue: Inconsistent sentinel values for prices vs. coordinates
codeSmells.detail: Prices use -1 (don't update) and -2 (clear). Coordinates use -1 (don't update) and -2.0 (clear). absoluteEventNumber uses 0 (clear) and -1 (don't update). At least three different sentinel patterns in one SP.

codeSmells.issue: DATALENGTH used instead of LEN for string checks
codeSmells.detail: All string empty-checks use DATALENGTH. For NVARCHAR, DATALENGTH returns 2× the character count. This means a single-character string has DATALENGTH=2 and passes the '< 2' check only if the string is truly empty. Misleading and inconsistent.

codeSmells.issue: No transaction wrapping the write operations
codeSmells.detail: The INSERT or UPDATE, followed by nonApi_updateRunNumbers, and then the sync SP all run outside a transaction.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change sentinel values (-1, -2, -2.0, 0, '<remove>', '<none>') without updating all callers
